description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/22/2026 Meet the Team  
  
 Cisco Enterprise Network Wireless and Cloud Escalations Team to support platforms that cover a $4B portfolio. Team represents highest point of escalation any Cisco customer & collaborates with cross-functional teams to resolve customer adoption barriers on priority. Team has rich history of WiFi expertise with team members part of IEEE, Patents, Authors, Industry known presenters and tech savvy engineers.

 Your Impact  
  
 The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Technical Lead will also connect customer experience directly to Cisco’s product and business unit teams. When a customer’s advanced use case exposes a product gap or creates an opportunity for innovation, the FDE will bring the right teams together to develop, validate and integrate a solution back into the customer’s environment.
  
 This role combines customer engagement, wireless architecture, hands-on engineering and cross-functional technical leadership. Success requires the ability to earn customer trust, navigate complex enterprise environments and turn field insights into product improvements that can benefit customers more broadly. In this role you will:
   
 Embed with customer IT, networking, security and operations teams to understand their environment, business priorities and technical requirements.
 Lead the adoption, deployment and optimization of Cisco Wireless solutions, including Cisco Catalyst and Meraki wireless platforms where applicable.
 Design and implement solutions for complex wireless use cases, including high-density connectivity, roaming, security, client interoperability, assurance and operational automation.
 Assess the customer’s existing architecture and recommend practical improvements to performance, reliability, scale and manageability.
 Work hands-on with customer and Cisco teams to troubleshoot complex issues, identify root causes and validate fixes in lab and production environments.
 Identify advanced customer requirements and product gaps. Translate them into clear use cases, technical requirements and evidence for product management and engineering teams.
 Partner with Cisco product and business unit teams to shape solutions, establish priorities and accelerate development.
 Coordinate prototypes, early releases and validation with the customer, then guide integration into the customer’s environment.
 Develop test plans and acceptance criteria that reflect the customer’s topology, devices, applications and operating conditions.
 Provide technical leadership across Cisco engineering, product management, support, sales and customer success teams, with clear ownership and communication.
 Capture reusable architectures, configurations, tools and lessons learned to improve outcomes for other customers.
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 

 Bachelors + 12 years of related experience, or Masters + 8 years of related experience, or PhD + 5 years of related experience, or equivalent related work experience.
 5 + years of experience designing, deploying or operating enterprise wireless networks in customer environments including but not limited to Wi-Fi architecture and protocols, RF design, wireless security, client connectivity, roaming and troubleshooting.
 Experience with networking technologies such as switching, routing, DHCP, DNS, RADIUS, 802.1X and network segmentation and experience deploying or supporting Cisco Wireless solutions, such as Catalyst Wireless or Meraki, or comparable wireless platforms.
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical engagements and work effectively as part of a customer’s engineering or IT organization.
 Experience translating customer requirements into technical designs, product requirements or engineering deliverables.
 Ability to investigate issues across clients, access points, controllers, switches and supporting network services.
 Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and senior leaders.
 Sound judgment in managing customer expectations, prioritizing work and coordinating across teams with different objectives.
 Building automation, integrations or tools using APIs and scripting languages such as Python.
 Working with network assurance, telemetry, packet analysis and observability tools.
 Validating new features or releases in customer labs, pilots or production environments.
 Collaborating with product engineering on feature development, defect resolution or platform integration.
 Supporting large-scale, high-density or business-critical wireless deployments.
 Leading geographically distributed technical teams or engagements.
 
 Why Cisco? 
 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 
 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 
 
 Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:
 
The starting salary range posted for this position is $214,100.00 to $309,800.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits. 
 Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.
 
 U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks.  Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.
 
 U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:
 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

 Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

 Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

 Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

 Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

 
 For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.
 
 Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:
 .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

 Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

 
 For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.
 
 The applicable full salary ranges for this position, by specific state, are listed below:
 
 New York City Metro Area:
$214,100.00 - $356,300.00 
 Non-Metro New York state & Washington state:
$192,400.00 - $317,200.00 
 * For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.
 ** Employees in Illinois, whether exempt or non-exempt, will participate in a unique time off program to meet local requirements.
